svg.title: How Sovereign Alpha is put together
svg.desc: Module I: extraction: Ingestion (Filings, central-bank statements, labour data and news into a raw corpus.); Language model and personas (Reads each document as six analyst personas.) Then: Data lake: Alpha Ledger (One signal table per persona, in partitioned Parquet.); Price bars (OHLCV history.) Then: Module II: quant engine: As-of fusion (Joins signals to prices on monotonic timestamps only, so nothing leaks from the future.); Backtest runner (Strategy rules, slippage and commission, then Sharpe, Sortino and out-of-sample checks.) Then: Module III: digital twin: Message bus (ZeroMQ and MessagePack.); Unreal Engine 5 client (Plays the run back as a 3D scene.)
